notes.title: The Girl and the Robot Card Game coming to Kickstarter October 24th
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we will launch a card game variation of our video game The Girl and the Robot on Kickstarter October 24th 2019.

The Girl and the Robot – The Card Game is a Russian roulette inspired strategic card game that involves protecting yourself and your teammate in the award winning video game setting of The Girl and the Robot.

The game features:

    A unique blend of cooperative and competitive gameplay
    Easy to learn and hard to master
    For 2 to 4 players
    Age 10 and Up
    30-45 minutes of play time

You can get notified as soon as the Kickstarter goes live by going to the Pre-Launch page here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flyingcarpets/the-girl-and-the-robot-the-card-game

Here are some other useful links:
Official page: https://flyingcarpetsgames.com/the-girl-and-the-robot-the-card-game/
Board Game Geek Page: https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/290024/girl-and-robot-card-game
Press Kit: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/fsz8hxdll3zq0yq/AACFwWjPRQvdEkue-Uq0u4EGa?dl=0

notes.title: The Girl and the Robot card game is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all,
If you enjoyed The Girl and the Robot, know that we are now working on a new card game variation that delves even more into the fantasy world and that will be available soon on Kickstarter!

Take on the role of the girl and the robot as you battle the evil queen in this strategic card game inspired by concepts from Russian roulette and classic shedding card games.

Stay tuned for more news by signing up to our mailing list here:
https://mailchi.mp/266ab49583be/fcg
In the meantime, here's our promo video:
https://youtu.be/7QgcqRWNR4g
Thank you for you support :)

notes.title: Version 1.0 Ready! Steam release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's with great pleasure that I announce our Steam release date:
Thursday August 18 2016

Our Steam page is online, please help us spread the word:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/270070/

It's been a long journey and me and my team are very grateful for this experience of making a first game as an indie developer. Again, Thank you :)

Salim & The Girl and the Robot Team
